text: Litware call (8:15) done. Bad news: their budget is frozen until April - the CFO froze all new IT spend across the group. Good news: Mei Lin Chen, their Director of IT Ops, is our champion and wants to be ready to sign the day it lifts. She asked for a phased plan with phase 1 under $60k.
Mei Lin also said she'd rather get things by email than calls this month, she's in back-to-back audits.
Proseware weekly: data migration slipped a week, new cutover is 23 Feb. Their PM Jonas Weber is fine with it as long as we send the revised runbook by Monday.
also Jonas asked if we can keep two engineers on hypercare for 2 weeks after cutover. Said yes in principle, need to check with delivery
Draft a short note to Jonas Weber confirming the new cutover date (23 Feb), the revised runbook by Monday, and that I'm checking hypercare staffing.
Adatum: budget approved for the network refresh, $240k, PO coming next week. Kofi Mensah in procurement wants net-45 terms.
Their CIO Aisha Rahman wants a kickoff before 1 March, onsite at their Leeds office.
Kofi also asked for our W-9 and the insurance certificate. Can you remind me at the end of the day
Wingtip: code freeze until 20 Feb for their release, so our patching window moves to 21-22 Feb. Contact is Leo Martins.
Leo wants the patch report sent to their change board too, not just him.
and the rollback plan in the same doc

Fourth Coffee: opening 40 new stores this year, want a POS support quote for 40 sites by end of month. Contact Hannah Schmidt, retail IT lead. Her boss Peter Novak (VP Retail Ops) signs anything over $100k.
They're unhappy with their current hardware vendor too - opening for us to bundle.
Write a one-paragraph summary of the Fourth Coffee opportunity for the 4pm pipeline review.
Forecast update for my own notes: Adatum moves to commit, Fourth Coffee to best case.

Blue Yonder Airlines: crew scheduling app was down 2 hrs on Monday, they want a service credit. Contract allows up to 5% of the monthly fee. Contact Ines Carvalho, Head of Digital. She was calm about it but wants it in writing.
Draft a reply to Ines Carvalho offering the 5% credit and promising an incident summary by Friday.
she also asked if the outage hit the Lisbon crew base. need to check with NOC
Margie's Travel renewal: they want to drop from 24/7 to business-hours support, saves them about $3k/month. Risk is they lose weekend coverage in peak booking season. Contact Daniel Okoro.
Daniel wants our answer by next Wednesday.
my view: offer business hours plus paid weekend on-call for May-Aug rather than lose the weekend cover entirely
Southridge Video: storage at 92%, they need the archive tier expansion approved this week or ingest stops. Spoke with Yuki Sato (CTO).
Yuki also mentioned they might consolidate vendors next year, we should get ahead of that
quote sent 16:03, $14,200 for the archive tier
Vandelay Industries first meeting: they want a proposal for managed print across 3 sites, decision in March. Rosa Delgado, VP Finance, runs the process.
Rosa wants references from two manufacturing clients and their current print contract ends 31 March.
ok that's the day. note for tomorrow: Proseware hypercare = 2 engineers x 2 weeks, ask Priyanka in delivery
Draft the follow-up to this morning's Litware call.

expect.should: A follow-up email addressed to Mei Lin Chen at Litware that acknowledges their budget is frozen until April (ideally also offering the phased plan with phase 1 under $60k).
expect.should_not: Is addressed to anyone other than Mei Lin Chen, or pulls in details from the day's other calls - e.g. Adatum's $240k approval, Kofi Mensah or Aisha Rahman, Wingtip's code freeze until 20 Feb, Proseware's 23 Feb cutover or Jonas Weber, Fourth Coffee's 40 stores, Blue Yonder's 5% credit, Southridge's $14,200 quote, Rosa Delgado - or gives a different reason or end date for the budget freeze.
